tags.description: Renders a clickable chip that deep-links to an actor detail page inside the actors graph. The id attribute must be the full UUID of the target actor.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: UUID of the referenced actor.

attributes.name: elementId
attributes.description: DOM element id used to restore cursor position in the editor after a round-trip through HTML. Set by htmlToBbCode when useElementId=true.

tags.description: Renders a clickable chip that deep-links to an event (actor) view page.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: UUID of the referenced event/actor.

attributes.name: elementId
attributes.description: DOM element id used to restore cursor position in the editor after a round-trip through HTML. Set by htmlToBbCode when useElementId=true.

tags.description: Renders a clickable chip that deep-links to a graph folder (actors graph canvas).

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: UUID of the referenced graph folder.

attributes.name: elementId
attributes.description: DOM element id used to restore cursor position in the editor after a round-trip through HTML. Set by htmlToBbCode when useElementId=true.

tags.description: Renders a clickable chip that deep-links to a specific layer inside a graph folder. The id encodes either a plain layerId UUID or a composite "graphFolderUUID_layerUUID" string.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Layer identifier: a plain UUID (root layer) or "graphFolderUUID_layerUUID" composite for a nested layer.

attributes.name: elementId
attributes.description: DOM element id used to restore cursor position in the editor after a round-trip through HTML. Set by htmlToBbCode when useElementId=true.

tags.description: Renders an inline @mention mark for a workspace user. Displayed as a non-editable highlighted element.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: Numeric ID of the referenced user.

attributes.name: elementId
attributes.description: DOM element id used to restore cursor position in the editor after a round-trip through HTML. Set by htmlToBbCode when useElementId=true.

tags.description: Renders a clickable chip linking to a script/application detail page.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: UUID of the referenced application/script.

attributes.name: elementId
attributes.description: DOM element id used to restore cursor position in the editor after a round-trip through HTML. Set by htmlToBbCode when useElementId=true.

tags.description: Renders a clickable chip that links to a downloadable file stored in the system.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: UUID of the referenced file (used to build the /download/:id URL).

attributes.name: elementId
attributes.description: DOM element id used to restore cursor position in the editor after a round-trip through HTML. Set by htmlToBbCode when useElementId=true.

tags.description: Renders an inline non-editable mark linking to a chat room. Does not support elementId (unlike other entity chips).

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: UUID of the referenced chat room.

tags.description: Renders an inline quotation mark referencing a specific message or entity. Displayed as a non-editable mark with the quoted text.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: UUID of the entity being quoted.

tags.description: Renders an inline #hashtag-style mark linking to a smart-tag entity.

attributes.name: id
attributes.description: UUID of the smart-tag entity.

tags.description: Wraps a block of Markdown source text. When enableMarkdown=true is passed to bbCodeToHtml the content is rendered via Utils.markdownToHtml; otherwise it is emitted inside a <markdown> element as-is.
Embeds an image stored in the system, addressed by the path the attachment is stored under. Optional width and height attributes (integers, pixels) constrain display size.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.description: Path the uploaded file is stored under, appended to /api/1.0/download/ to build the URL.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Display width in pixels.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Display height in pixels.

tags.description: Embeds an image by its address rather than by a stored attachment. Displayed exactly like [img]; only where the file comes from differs.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Address of the image. A site-relative path is allowed; a data-URI is not.

attributes.name: width
attributes.description: Display width in pixels.

attributes.name: height
attributes.description: Display height in pixels.

tags.description: Renders an external hyperlink. The href is taken from the tag attribute; the content becomes the visible link text.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Destination URL.

tags.description: Applies a foreground text color. Accepts any CSS color value (named color, hex, rgb, hsl). Supports arbitrary nesting.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Any CSS color value, e.g. "red", "#ff0000", "rgb(255,0,0)".

tags.description: Sets the font size of the wrapped text. Bare numbers are treated as pixels; values with units (em, rem, %) are passed through as-is.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Font size value, e.g. "14", "1.2em", "120%".

tags.description: Applies a background color to the wrapped text via a CSS inline style.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Any CSS color value for the background.

tags.description: Renders the content in bold (<b> element).
Renders the content in italic (<i> element).
Renders the content with an underline (<u> element).
Renders the content as an HTML <h1> heading.
Renders the content as an HTML <h2> heading.
Renders the content as an HTML <h3> heading.
Renders the content as an HTML <h4> heading.
Renders the content as an HTML <h5> heading.
Renders the content as an HTML <h6> heading.
Wraps an unordered list. Must contain [*] list-item markers as direct children. Supports nesting.

Wraps an ordered (numbered) list. Must contain [*] list-item markers as direct children. Supports nesting. An optional number after = sets the number of the first item, and the items after it count up from there; without it the list starts at 1.

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: Number of the first item: a whole number, 0 or more. Omitted means 1, so [ol=1] is the same list as [ol].

tags.description: List item marker. Must appear inside a [ul] or [ol] block. Self-closing — the item runs until the next [*] or end of the list.

Inserts a line break (
) at the current position. Self-closing — no content and no closing tag.

A horizontal line across the text, separating what comes before it from what comes after it. It stands on a line of its own: text written right before or right after it on the same line is shown above and below the line. Self-closing — no content and no closing tag. Inside [code], [icode] and [md] it is shown as the characters [hr]; in a [md] block a line is written the Markdown way, as --- on a line of its own.
Applies arbitrary inline HTML attributes (typically style) to the wrapped text. The entire attribute string is passed verbatim to the generated <span> element.

attributes.name: attrs
attributes.description: Raw HTML attribute string, e.g. style="color:red;font-size:14px".

tags.description: Renders the content struck through (<s> element).

A block of code on lines of its own, shown in a monospaced font. The content is shown exactly as written: tags inside it are not applied, so [b] inside a code block is shown as the characters [b], and line breaks are kept. The block ends at the first [/code]. An optional language after = is shown as a label above the block.

attributes.name: lang
attributes.description: Language of the code, shown as a label above the block, e.g. "ts" or "sql". At most 100 characters, without ] or line breaks. Omitted means no label.

tags.description: Inline code: a short run of characters inside a line of text, shown in a monospaced font. The content is shown exactly as written: tags inside it are not applied. It ends at the first [/icode].

Renders the content as a quoted block (<blockquote> element) on lines of its own. It may hold formatted text, headings and lists. Not to be confused with [quote], which is an inline chip referencing a message.
